title: Peace with God, Death in Adam, Life in Christ

questions.question: Therefore, since we have been justified by faith, what do we have with God through our Lord Jesus Christ?
questions.explanation: Romans 5:1 (ESV): "Therefore, since we have been justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ."

questions.question: We rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces endurance, and endurance produces character, and character produces what?
questions.explanation: Romans 5:3-4 (ESV): "Not only that, but we rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces endurance, and endurance produces character, and character produces hope,"

questions.question: Why does hope not put us to shame?
options: Because God's love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit
Because God is faithful who has promised
Because Christ sits at the right hand of the Father interceding for us
Because we have already received the down payment of our inheritance
questions.correctAnswer: Because God's love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit
questions.explanation: Romans 5:5 (ESV): "and hope does not put us to shame, because God's love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who has been given to us."

questions.question: For while we were still weak, at the right time Christ died for whom?
questions.explanation: Romans 5:6 (ESV): "For while we were still weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly."

questions.question: God shows his love for us in that while we were still sinners, what happened?
questions.explanation: Romans 5:8 (ESV): "but God shows his love for us in that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us."

questions.question: Since we have now been justified by his blood, much more shall we be saved by him from what?
questions.explanation: Romans 5:9 (ESV): "Since, therefore, we have now been justified by his blood, much more shall we be saved by him from the wrath of God."

questions.question: If while we were enemies we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, now that we are reconciled, shall we be saved by what?
questions.explanation: Romans 5:10 (ESV): "For if while we were enemies we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, now that we are reconciled, shall we be saved by his life."

questions.question: Sin came into the world through one man, and death through sin. Thus death spread to all men because...
questions.explanation: Romans 5:12 (ESV): "Therefore, just as sin came into the world through one man, and death through sin, and so death spread to all men because all sinned—"

questions.question: Paul notes that sin was indeed in the world before the law was given, but sin is not counted where there is no what?
questions.explanation: Romans 5:13 (ESV): "for sin indeed was in the world before the law was given, but sin is not counted where there is no law."

questions.question: Death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over those whose sinning was not like the transgression of Adam. What is Adam described as a type of in verse 14?
options: A type of the one who was to come
A type of the physical body of Christ
A type of the old covenant
questions.correctAnswer: A type of the one who was to come
questions.explanation: Romans 5:14 (ESV): "Yet death reigned from Adam to Moses... Adam, who was a type of the one who was to come."

questions.question: If many died through one man's trespass, much more have the grace of God and the free gift by the grace of that one man Jesus Christ ____ for many.
questions.explanation: Romans 5:15 (ESV): "...much more have the grace of God and the free gift by the grace of that one man Jesus Christ abounded for many."

questions.question: Because of one man's trespass, death reigned. Much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and the free gift of righteousness reign in life through whom?
questions.explanation: Romans 5:17 (ESV): "...much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and the free gift of righteousness reign in life through the one man Jesus Christ."

questions.question: As one trespass led to condemnation for all men, so one act of righteousness leads to what for all men?
questions.explanation: Romans 5:18 (ESV): "Therefore, as one trespass led to condemnation for all men, so one act of righteousness leads to justification and life for all men."

questions.question: As by the one man's disobedience the many were made sinners, so by the one man's obedience the many will be made what?
questions.explanation: Romans 5:19 (ESV): "For as by the one man's disobedience the many were made sinners, so by the one man's obedience the many will be made righteous."

questions.question: The law came in to increase the trespass, but where sin increased, what abounded all the more?
questions.explanation: Romans 5:20 (ESV): "Now the law came in to increase the trespass, but where sin increased, grace abounded all the more,"

key_verse_text: but God shows his love for us in that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
